description: Create a program (the cross-initiative grouping). Use this to set up a body of work before adding initiatives under it. To have it take incoming requests, call anyforge_set_program_request_intake afterwards. Requires `write` scope.

longLived.description: true for a standing program that never ends (an intake queue, a run stream). Absent = a bounded program.

ownerId.description: Owning operator uid. Defaults to the key user.

programLeadUid.description: Program lead uid: must be an approved member of the workspace. The lead decides where the program's incoming requests go and is who request reminders tag.

name: anyforge_create_program
title: Create program
